review_description: From start to finish, the service was absolutely outstanding. Jake and the boys were professional, friendly, and went above and beyond to make sure everything ran smoothly. The product quality is excellent, and the installation was completed efficiently with great attention to detail.The administration team was also fantastic, very informative, responsive, and professional throughout the whole process. Communication was clear and consistent, which made the entire experience stress-free.Couldn’t be happier with the results! thanks again to Jake and the team at Apex Energy Solutions!

Jake and his team supplied and installed solar at my house. They were knowledgeable, reliable, professional, and did an excellent job over 2 days.Excellent service.System works great.Left everything clean and tidy.Highly recommend them.
Apex replaced our inverter under a warranty claim. Organised everything with no issues.

As soon as we enquired we had fast communication and quote to us. Speedy installation and great value for money. The after care and customer service was ++++. Always checking in and happy to answer any questions.

I recently had an incredible experience with Apex Energy Solutions when I decided to install solar panels on my home. From the initial consultation to the final installation, the process was seamless and professional.Jake and his team conducted a thorough site assessment, helping us determine the optimal placement for the solar panels. Their expertise made me feel confident in my decision.Once installed, the work was quick, tidy, and efficient. I was amazed to see the impact on my electricity bills right away. Before going solar, I was paying around $600 a month. Now, my bills have drastically dropped to just $50-$70!This change has allowed me to save a significant amount of money, which I can now spend on my children and invest back into my household. It’s truly made a difference for my single-income family.I wholeheartedly recommend Apex Energy Solutions to anyone considering solar energy. I’ve already shared my positive experience with friends and family. This investment has been one of the best decisions I've made!

Apex energy solutions done a fantastic job on our solar system.
